source_identity.title: LO2v2: An Updated and Improved Microservice Dataset of Logs and Metrics

run_and_execution_group_contract.collection_method: Locust tests with Docker daemon logs, cAdvisor, NodeExporter, Prometheus, and Jaeger instrumentation
run_and_execution_group_contract.curator_definition_of_run: An execution of all possible defined tests; one correct test and 53 error tests.
run_and_execution_group_contract.candidate_source_native_group: one complete curator-defined run containing all 54 tests
run_and_execution_group_contract.run_identifier_semantics: The UNIX value is the timestamp at which the complete run began.
run_and_execution_group_contract.fail_closed_rule: The 115 curator-declared runs are metadata-level grouping candidates only. No run, test, timestamp, directory, service, container, metric, trace, or log receives lineage credit until a separately authorized manifest audit verifies unique complete runs, duplicate and retry handling, and repeated-system nuisance.

label_supervision_and_physical_isolation.prior_lo2_curator_warning: The predecessor LO2 record states that initialization rows at the beginning of files leak information regarding correctness and calls reduce_logs.py important for fair analysis.
label_supervision_and_physical_isolation.fail_closed_rule: The index may be used only for bounded manifest auditing until test and task names, correct or error labels, expected outcomes, error targets, label-bearing paths, initialization leakage, and analysis derivatives are physically excluded under a frozen contract.

candidate_claim_ir_fit.evidence_surface: Microservice runtime logs, host and container metrics, and distributed traces produced during controlled test runs
candidate_claim_ir_fit.scientific_limit: This source may test candidate-only editing over controlled operational provenance, but it cannot be presented as APT, malware, host-forensics, or security-incident evidence and cannot substitute for those modalities without a separately approved scientific portfolio argument.

pointer_assessment.candidate_index_pointer_shape: record DOI + immutable index checksum + source-native run identifier + deterministic JSON record or object location
pointer_assessment.candidate_runtime_pointer_shape: record DOI + immutable runtime artifact checksum + source-native run identifier + immutable archive member identity + record or interval position
pointer_assessment.fail_closed_rule: An index pointer may at most point to an index manifest record. It must not be reused as evidence binding for logs, metrics, traces, or archive members that were not independently identified and verified by the program binder.

future_exact_bounded_review_requirements: If separately authorized, freeze an exact bounded acquisition contract for LO2v2_index.json only, using 31028530 bytes and MD5 2efcff67820ba1df40fae362919271eb.
Do not acquire LO2v2.zip, LO2v2-metrics.zip, light-oauth2-logs.zip, light-oauth2.zip, or light-oauth2-metrics.zip under the index contract.

Before reading JSON, pin the reader implementation, executable or package identity, SHA-256, invocation, parser, maximum bytes, maximum object and depth counts, timeout, redaction, and fail-closed behavior.

Limit the first execution to schema, bounded notice, manifest, and run-grouping probes. Do not persist raw run IDs, test names, task names, paths, timestamps, service identifiers, or ordinary index values.
Verify exactly 115 unique non-empty source-native run candidates and 54 tests per complete run without treating tests as independent lineages.
Audit missing, partial, aborted, retry, duplicate, or repeated run handling and record whether the same runtime, image, revision, host, seed, cache, or background state induces shared nuisance.
Physically exclude correct or error labels, specific error task names, expected outcomes, analysis outputs, label-bearing paths, and any initialization-row leakage proxy.
Treat log, trace, and metric counts or sizes as potentially label-bearing derived fields until separately cleared.
Compare v1 and v2 run identities and immutable artifact identities for exact or near overlap without using v1 payload or labels under the current authority.
Prove deterministic index-pointer round trip. Keep every pointer unbound or ambiguous unless the program binder verifies artifact, run, and JSON location.
Do not use an index pointer as evidence binding for unopened log, metric, trace, or archive content.

Even if the index audit passes, require a separate source-role review and a separately frozen safe evidence-surface contract before any runtime data acquisition, role assignment, split, sample, or credit decision.

evidence: Zenodo revision 4 and DataCite agree on a findable Dataset DOI, open access, CC-BY-4.0 dataset rights, creator identity, and six exact artifact identities with byte sizes and MD5 checksums.

The curator defines a Run as one execution of all 54 tests and declares 115 such runs, so the metadata-candidate grouping threshold is satisfied without counting files, directories, labels, attacks, configurations, or analyst-created time windows.
Every run contains one correct and 53 error tests, and the index is declared to include test order and timing.
The predecessor LO2 record explicitly warns that initialization rows leak correctness information and requires a reduction script for fair analysis.
The source is a controlled microservice observability dataset, not security-incident, APT, malware, or host-forensics telemetry.

No reviewed metadata proves unique completed runs, retry or duplicate handling, repeated-system independence, label isolation, v1/v2 disjointness, nested notices, privacy safety, or pointer recoverability.
inference: Immutable identity, rights, and source-native run semantics are sufficient to approve LO2v2 as a metadata candidate.
The 115 runs cannot receive lineage or sample credit because repeated-system nuisance, completion, duplicate, retry, and temporal correlation remain unverified.
The index is a potential manifest surface only. Its test identities and summary values may leak supervision and it is not Candidate Claim IR evidence by itself.
The predecessor correctness-leak warning must be treated as unresolved for v2 until a frozen bounded audit proves physical isolation.
The source's scientific value is conditional on a later argument for operational provenance; metadata review cannot promote it into a security evidence role.
recommendation: Approve only as metadata candidate, not source role.
Do not write the effective catalog, download any object, assign a split, generate samples, or award family, lineage, sample, or quota credit under the current authority.
If separately authorized, make LO2v2_index.json the only object in the first exact bounded acquisition contract.
Use the first bounded execution only for schema, notice, 115-run manifest, duplicate or retry, protected-label, v1/v2 overlap, and pointer-candidate auditing.
Fail closed if explicit labels, error task identities, initialization leak proxies, service identifiers, ordinary values, or prior-version overlap cannot be physically isolated.
A successful index audit must lead to an independent source-role disposition, not automatic admission or bulk runtime archive acquisition.
